title: Delivery
description: A Delivery, as stored in `beta-3-g<N>-deliveries` for `POST /deliveries`, or the empty one `POST /receipts` creates for an undocumented Receipt.

requestId.description: The `x-request-id` the API returned to the request that created the Delivery. Every Delivery one `POST /deliveries` recorded has the same one.

payload.description: The `POST /deliveries` request body, kept whole by every Delivery it recorded, or for the empty Delivery of an undocumented Receipt, the `POST /receipts` request body, which its Receipt keeps too.

payloadHash.description: The hash of its `payload`: shared by every Delivery one `POST /deliveries` recorded, and by an undocumented Receipt and its empty Delivery.

deliveryId.description: The Delivery ID: minted for the non-hazardous Movements' Delivery and an undocumented Receipt's, or a hazardous Movement's own Movement ID. Not unique, as a resubmitted hazardous Movement has a Delivery per submission.

movementIds.description: The Movements delivered. Empty for an undocumented Receipt's Delivery.

wasteType.description: Whether the waste delivered is hazardous: any waste item declaring hazardous properties makes it so. Worked out from the Movements delivered, or for an undocumented Receipt's Delivery, from the waste items of its own request.
